issuing_body: Minnesota Legislature / Office of the Revisor of Statutes
author: State of Minnesota
title: 2026 Minnesota Laws, Chapter 121
notes: Official Revisor session-law source for 2026 amendments affecting Minnesota Medical Assistance program-integrity authorities, including section 256B.064. Exact effective dates and subdivision text should be cited from the enacted article rather than inferred from the still-transitioning permanent-statutes display.
supports: Chapter 121 is the primary enacted source for the 2026 amendments to section 256B.064 identified in the gap ledger.
The session law can be used for post-effective-date citations while the Revisor's permanent-statutes display is being consolidated.
does_not_support: Any paraphrase that omits or overrides the act's own effective-date language.
A claim that the permanent 2026 statutory compilation has already been finalized.
